terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: BuenServ connects people seeking services with independent providers in Buenos Aires. It is not a party to the service contract between client and provider. The parties agree directly on scope, price and payment method.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We process profile data, contact details, site use, bot interactions and support requests to operate BuenServ, prevent abuse and meet applicable obligations.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.body: We use local storage and necessary technologies to remember language preferences and support basic site functionality. Aggregated analytics may be used to improve the service.

legal.notice: Document under legal review. It must not be treated as a final policy until approved by Argentine legal counsel.
